suite: World View Field Package Canonical Manifest V2 Validation Vectors
schema: P2-09-36 Field Package Canonical Manifest Schema V0.2
status: design vectors; executable validator and package-reader integration pending

compatibility.manifest_v1: legacy-read-only for already published revisions; must not be used for new elevation publication
compatibility.manifest_v2: required for new formal Field Revision publication
compatibility.package_envelope: WVFLDPK format 1.0 remains unchanged; manifest schema version is an independent version axis

cases.case: Elevation V2 declares unit m, stable vertical_reference_id, coordinate_precision_profile_id and valid grid metadata.
Elevation V2 declares unit ft; unit conversion to the calculation canonical unit is deterministic and recorded in provenance.
Reject elevation V2 without field.unit.
Reject elevation V2 with a unit other than m or ft.
Reject elevation V2 without spatial.vertical_reference_id.
Reject empty, whitespace-only or overlength vertical_reference_id.
Land/water V2 declares coordinate_precision_profile_id and omits dimensional unit and vertical_reference_id.
Reject land_water V2 when a dimensional unit or vertical_reference_id is supplied; do not attach elevation semantics to categorical values.
Reject V2 manifest without spatial.coordinate_precision_profile_id.
Reject a coordinate precision profile ID that does not match the immutable profile selected by the referenced Spatial Reference definition.
Reject a vertical_reference_id that cannot be resolved to an immutable locally available vertical-reference definition before production publication.
Reject a spatial_reference_id whose immutable definition is unavailable or whose declared coordinate unit/axis/domain conflicts with the grid.
Treat grid resolution as spacing_x/spacing_y plus width/height; tile_width/tile_height describe storage tiling and do not redefine semantic resolution.
Treat grid alignment as origin_x/origin_y, axis_orientation and cell_registration; preserve all values exactly.
Reject incomplete resolution semantics when either spacing or either grid dimension is missing or invalid.
Reject incomplete grid alignment semantics when origin, axis orientation or cell registration is missing or invalid.
Keep coordinate_precision_profile_id separate from value_encoding.profile_id; one governs coordinate quantization and the other governs sample representation.
Reject a fixture-only value encoding profile for production publication.
Read a previously published V1 revision as legacy metadata without inventing unit, vertical reference or coordinate precision profile values.
Reject a new formal elevation publication using Manifest V1 even if its old V1 shape passes schema validation.
Keep WVFLDPK envelope format 1.0 while using manifest_schema.version 2; the two version axes are independent.
Reject unknown V2 properties, duplicate JSON keys, invalid UTF-8 and non-canonical JCS bytes under the existing canonicalization contract.
